description:
Non-required findings surfaced by the code review of the timing-policy hook
split (commit 0c8e6e2ba) and its follow-up fixes (default_install_hook_types,
list[Finding] typing, and removing the dead marker gate in conftest).

All Required/Critical fixes from the review have landed. This item tracks
three deferred polish/robustness items that were intentionally scoped out of
the immediate fix.

preserves.behavior: DB-setup subprocess in conftest.py still runs for all currently-passing invocations
timing-policy-check pre-commit hook stays <1s (allowlist scan only)
timing-policy-fast-lane pre-push hook still runs pytest --collect-only

verifications.description: Typecheck still clean after TypedDict promotion (w3)
Fast tests still pass if w2 is implemented

work_units.notes:
`default_install_hook_types: [pre-commit, pre-push]` in
.pre-commit-config.yaml:6 only takes effect on the next
`pre-commit install` invocation.  Contributors who already ran
`pre-commit install` before that key was added will NOT automatically
get the pre-push `timing-policy-fast-lane` hook (:30-35) until they
re-run install.

Without local pre-push enforcement, fast-lane violations are caught
only in CI (.github/workflows/lint.yml:40) - the exact regression the
Fix 1 change was meant to prevent.

Decide between:
  (a) Add a one-line note to CONTRIBUTING.md:37 and
      docs/contributing-results.md:140 telling existing contributors
      to re-run `pre-commit install` once.
  (b) Accept CI-only enforcement for existing clones and drop the
      claim; document that fresh clones get both stages.

A prior attempt at (a) was reverted; confirm author intent before
re-applying.
work_units.summary: Document pre-commit re-install requirement for existing clones

work_units.notes:
tests/conftest.py:270 - the dead marker gate was removed because
`session.items` is empty at `pytest_sessionstart` (pre-collection).
Consequence: DB setup via `tests/databases/create_test_databases.py`
runs on every pytest invocation, including `-m fast`.

Currently harmless - DB creation is idempotent and cheap.  If the
subprocess cost grows past ~1s (e.g., more test-DB fixtures are
added), re-introduce the gate in `pytest_collection_modifyitems`
where `session.items` is populated.

Prerequisite before wiring the gate: audit "unit" tests for implicit
DB dependency.  Any unit test that reads/writes `tests/databases/*.duckdb`
without declaring the `database` or `integration` marker must either
gain the marker or be refactored, or the gated skip will break it.
work_units.summary: Gate DB-setup properly in pytest_collection_modifyitems if cost grows

work_units.notes:
_project/scripts/timing_policy_check.py:18,26 - `_load_allowlist`
returns `list[dict[str, Any]]` and `_load_fast_lane_policy` returns
`dict[str, Any]`.

These are genuinely heterogeneous JSON structures (allowlist entries
carry optional `path_glob`, `symbol`, `line_regex`; fast-lane policy
mixes `enabled: bool`, `max_fast_tests: int`,
`forbidden_marker_expressions: list[str]`, `forbidden_path_substrings:
list[str]`).

Promote both to TypedDicts (`AllowlistEntry`, `FastLanePolicy`).
Improves type-checking on the `.get(...)` reads at :36-45 and :91-97.
Zero behavior change; pure hygiene.
work_units.summary: Tighten config-loader return types in timing_policy_check.py
